Torchic

Fire

Hoenn · Generation 3

Torchic is a Fire-type Chick Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 0.4 m tall and weighs 2.5 kg. It evolves into Combusken. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (70), with a base stat total of 310.
